query:
-- Forfait actuel
SELECT id, residentId, totalHours, usedHours, deductedMinutes, isActive, startDate, endDate 
FROM packages 
WHERE residentId = 1 AND isActive = 1
LIMIT 1;

-- Tous les pointages du forfait actuel
SELECT id, packageId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, durationMinutes, createdAt
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 AND packageId = 120003
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;

-- Somme totale des pointages
SELECT packageId, SUM(durationMinutes) as totalMinutes
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 AND packageId = 120003
GROUP BY packageId;
